learned.placeholder_note: an area sitting in a branch that was split but which was never placed in either child; the inherited helper would call it root, which is a default and not learned membership (R4)

notes: a child checkpoint may contain an adopted parent model when the F1 gate kept the parent for that side; spatial branch and model-fit provenance are different facts
checkpoints_not_routed are candidate children that were trained and then REJECTED by the F1 gate; no row routes to them and nothing downstream may load them
